verdict.rationale: Orama ships an answer engine. AnswerSession provides ChatGPT-like Q&A over your indexed data, proxied to OpenAI through the Secure Proxy, and the product is pitched as turning a question into a straight answer with its sources. That gives AI-generated answers grounded in your data, but these are reactive Q&A responses rather than proactive insights or suggestions. The orama.com CIC readiness score and Metis model training hint at data assessment, but no evidence shows them surfacing insights inside the product. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions within the product UI, documented analytics or recommendation features over user data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
